title.zh: 腾讯Hyra 2.0迈向AI自主科研：从头训练模型、设计机器人，甚至参与研发下一代AI
title.en: 腾讯Hyra 2.0迈向AI自主科研：从头训练模型、设计机器人，甚至参与研发下一代AI

current_state.zh: Tencent Hunyuan unveiled Hyra 2.0, a three-tier autonomous research agent that has trained protein models from scratch, improved a RISC-V processor and robotic hand design, and is now being used to help develop the next generation of Hunyuan AI models.
current_state.en: Tencent Hunyuan unveiled Hyra 2.0, a three-tier autonomous research agent that has trained protein models from scratch, improved a RISC-V processor and robotic hand design, and is now being used to help develop the next generation of Hunyuan AI models.
